comments.author: Alex Kim
comments.body: Docs live; marking done after two partner SDKs adopted the header.

content.text: Docs live; marking done after two partner SDKs adopted the header.

Mobile and flaky networks often retry POST /v2/issues and create duplicates when the first request succeeded but the response was lost. Clients need at-most-once semantics without building their own dedupe store.

Accept header Idempotency-Key (UUIDv4 recommended) on create endpoints. First request stores the response body and status for 24h keyed by (api_key_id, idempotency_key); replays return the stored response without re-executing side effects.
Acceptance: conflicting body hash for the same key returns 409; keys expire after 24h; documented for issues, comments, and webhook subscriptions create routes.
